versions.content: For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalT imeMaster = False ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ), the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation, which has been calculated for that Time Base (i.e., r rc - 1 for Synchronized Time Bases or r orc - 1 for Offset Time Bases). If no rate deviation has been calculated , StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .

For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster = False ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ), the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation, which has been calculated for that Time Base (i.e., r rc - 1 for Synchronized Time Bases or r orc - 1 for Offset Time Bases). If no rate deviation has been calculated , StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .

For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster = False ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ), the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation r Dev , which has been calculated for that Time Base . If no rate deviation has been calculated , StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .
